app.name: MenuMochi
app.description: A tiny emotional browser-tab pet that follows you across tabs with animated favicon faces, scrolling tab-title guilt trips, care buttons, diary entries, and Darren nonsense.
app.audience: Chrome/Edge users, Tamagotchi fans, productivity weirdos, browser-extension collectors, ADHD tabs goblins, cute desktop pet fans.
app.problem: Browsers feel dead, tabs are soulless, and people forget to take breaks or enjoy tiny interactions while working.
app.differentiator: cute guilt, gremlin sass, emotional blackmail, tiny companion

imageGen.basePrompt: vertical TikTok slideshow image for MenuMochi, cute guilt, gremlin sass, emotional blackmail, tiny companion style, clean readable composition, no text, no logos, no watermarks
